site.tagline: Connecting little hearts to the Holy Quran — one animal at a time.
site.author: Liliia Noor
site.intro: Discover the amazing animals mentioned in the Holy Quran through the eyes of Yusuf and Maryam — two curious children who meet a new Quran Animal in every book!
features: Introduces a real animal from the Quran
Includes fun facts, activities & colouring pages
site.seo: Islamic children's book series about Quran Animals. Perfect for Muslim children ages 5-8. Available in English, French and Russian. by Liliia Noor.

bundles.name: Any 3 books
bundles.about: Choose any three books. Signed by the author.

bundles.name: The whole series
bundles.about: All seven Quran Animals books, signed by the author.

books.name: Nur the Bee
books.hook: Did you know that the bee has its very own chapter in the Holy Quran?
books.description: Join Yusuf and Maryam as they meet Nur — a golden bee who shares the beautiful story of Surah An-Nahl (Chapter 16) and teaches children that hard work is a gift from Allah.
discover: Why Allah gave the bee her own Surah
The miracle of honey mentioned in the Quran 1,400 years ago
How to find strength in Allah when things feel hard
The exact words of Allah in Quran 16:68–69
books.includes: Quran verse, fun facts about bees, discussion questions, colouring pages and activities.
books.quote: And your Lord inspired the bee...
books.seo: Children's Islamic book about the bee mentioned in Surah An-Nahl. Teaches hard work and trust in Allah. Ages 5-8. Quran Animals Book 1 by Liliia Noor.

books.name: Ghuraab the Crow
books.hook: A wise crow. An important lesson. And a story written in the Holy Quran forever.
books.description: Join Yusuf and Maryam as they meet Ghuraab — a glossy black crow whose ancestor taught one of the most powerful lessons in the Quran: that wisdom can come from the most unexpected places.
discover: The story of the crow in Surah Al-Maidah (Chapter 5)
Why staying humble helps us learn and grow
That Allah can send wisdom through any of His creatures
The exact words of Allah in Quran 5:31
books.includes: Quran verse, fun facts about crows, discussion questions, colouring pages and activities.
books.quote: He said: Woe to me! Was I not able to be like this crow?
books.seo: Children's Islamic book about the crow in Surah Al-Maidah. Teaches humility and learning from others. Ages 5-8. Quran Animals Book 2 by Liliia Noor.

books.name: Namla the Ant
books.hook: She was tiny. But her voice changed everything.
books.description: Join Yusuf and Maryam as they meet Namla — a brave little ant who warned her entire community when the great army of Prophet Sulaiman approached. Her story is written in the Holy Quran in Surah An-Naml (Chapter 27 — "The Ants").
discover: The amazing story of the ant and Prophet Sulaiman
That even the smallest voice matters to Allah
The importance of caring for others in our community
The exact words of Allah in Quran 27:18–19
books.includes: Quran verses, fun facts about ants, discussion questions, colouring pages and activities.
books.quote: O ants! Enter your homes so that Sulaiman and his armies do not crush you without knowing!
books.seo: Children's Islamic book about the ant in Surah An-Naml. Teaches caring for others. Ages 5-8. Quran Animals Book 3 by Liliia Noor.

books.name: Feel the Elephant
books.hook: A mighty army. Tiny birds. And one brave elephant who chose to do what was right.
books.description: In this book Yusuf and Maryam fall asleep in the garden — and in their dream they are transported to an ancient valley where they witness the powerful story of Surah Al-Fil (Chapter 105 — "The Elephant").
discover: The story of the army of elephants and the birds Ababeel
How Allah protects what is sacred
The courage of Mahmud — the elephant who refused to dishonour Allah's house
Why true strength belongs only to Allah
The complete Surah Al-Fil (5 verses)
books.includes: Surah Al-Fil, fun facts about elephants, discussion questions, colouring pages, cut & paste activities.
books.quote: Have you not seen what your Lord did to the companions of the elephant?
books.seo: Children's Islamic book about the elephant in Surah Al-Fil. Teaches that all power belongs to Allah. Ages 5-8. Quran Animals Book 4 by Liliia Noor.

books.name: Hudhud the Hoopoe
books.hook: He was small. He was afraid. But he told the truth anyway.
books.description: In this book Yusuf and Maryam fall asleep under the stars — and in their dream they grow wings and fly alongside Hudhud the hoopoe bird on his most important mission: delivering a letter from Prophet Sulaiman to a faraway queen.
discover: The story of Hudhud in Surah An-Naml (Chapter 27)
That honesty is always the right path — even when it feels scary
How the smallest messenger can carry the most important news
The letter of Prophet Sulaiman (Quran 27:30)
books.includes: Quran verses, fun facts about hoopoe birds, discussion questions, colouring pages and activities.
books.quote: It is from Sulaiman, and it is: In the name of Allah, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate.
books.seo: Children's Islamic book about the hoopoe in Surah An-Naml. Teaches honesty and courage. Ages 5-8. Quran Animals Book 5 by Liliia Noor.

books.name: Nun the Whale
books.hook: The darkest place. The most powerful prayer.
books.description: In this book Yusuf and Maryam fall asleep by the sea — and in their dream they witness the incredible story of Prophet Yunus inside the belly of the whale. Three days. Three nights. Complete darkness. And one prayer that reached Allah.
discover: The story of Prophet Yunus and the whale
That Allah always hears our prayers — even from the deepest darkness
The prayer of Prophet Yunus (Quran 21:87)
Why we should never lose hope in Allah
books.includes: Quran verse, fun facts about whales, discussion questions, colouring pages and activities.
books.quote: There is no god but You! Glory be to You! I was truly one of the wrongdoers.
books.seo: Children's Islamic book about the whale and Prophet Yunus. Teaches hope and prayer. Ages 5-8. Quran Animals Book 6 by Liliia Noor.

books.name: Ankabut the Spider
books.hook: His web looks strong. But is it really?
books.description: Join Yusuf and Maryam as they meet Ankabut — a big fluffy black spider whose web holds one of the most powerful lessons in the Quran: that true protection comes only from Allah.
discover: What Allah says about the spider's web in Surah Al-Ankabut (Chapter 29)
Why we should put our trust only in Allah — not in things that can break
The beloved Islamic tradition of the spider who protected the Prophet ﷺ in the cave (clearly marked as tradition, not Quran)
The exact words of Allah in Quran 29:41
books.includes: Quran verse, fun facts about spiders, discussion questions, colouring pages and activities.
books.quote: Truly the weakest of houses is the house of the spider.
books.seo: Children's Islamic book about the spider in Surah Al-Ankabut. Teaches trust in Allah. Ages 5-8. Quran Animals Book 7 by Liliia Noor.

iftar_dua.ar: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
iftar_dua.tr: Dhahaba adh-dhama'u wabtallatil-'uruqu wa thabatal-ajru in sha' Allah
iftar_dua.en: The thirst is gone, the veins are moist, and the reward is certain, if Allah wills.

duas.ar: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.tr: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina 'adhaban-nar
duas.en: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

duas.ar: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي
duas.tr: Rabbish-rah li sadri wa yassir li amri
duas.en: My Lord, open my heart for me and make my task easy for me.

duas.ar: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
duas.en: Our Lord, accept this from us. You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

duas.ar: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
duas.tr: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minadh-dhalimin
duas.en: There is no god but You! Glory be to You! I was truly one of the wrongdoers.
duas.ref: Quran 21:87 · the dua of Prophet Yunus

duas.en: My Lord, have mercy on them as they raised me when I was small.
Allah is enough for us, and He is the best protector.
In the name of Allah. Say it before you eat, drink or start something.

last_ten_dua.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
last_ten_dua.en: O Allah, You are Forgiving and You love to forgive, so forgive me.
last_ten_dua.ref: Jami' at-Tirmidhi · for the last ten nights

deeds.t: Say Bismillah before every meal
Help set the table for iftar
Smile at everyone you meet. A smile is charity!
Give some of your pocket money to charity
Tidy your room without being asked
Say thank you to your mum or dad and give them a hug
Share a snack with a friend, brother or sister
Learn a new Arabic word
Help prepare food for iftar
Call or visit a grandparent
Tell the truth, even when it feels hard
Make dua for someone else today
Water a plant or put out water for the birds
Say SubhanAllah, Alhamdulillah and Allahu Akbar 10 times each
Learn the dua of Prophet Yunus by heart
Draw a picture for someone you love
Pick up litter at home, in the park or at the masjid
Be patient all day. No complaining!
Say something kind to three people
Listen to Surah Al-Fil with your family
Read or listen to a page of the Quran
Help wash the dishes after iftar
Taste a spoon of honey and say Alhamdulillah for it
Forgive someone who upset you
Make a card for a neighbour
Pray together with your family
Make extra dua tonight. It could be Laylat al-Qadr!
Give away a toy or clothes you no longer use
Ask a grandparent or older friend to tell you a story
Make Eid cards for your family
